description: This file defines a set of functions and classes for evaluating expressions within the vtiger CRM platform, including mathematical, date/time, and string operations, as well as an expression evaluation class.

classes.name: VTFieldExpressionEvaluater
classes.description: A class responsible for evaluating expression trees using a provided environment, supporting various operators and functions relevant to vtiger CRM.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the expression tree with the given environment object.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Recursively executes an expression node, handling operators, functions, symbols, and constants.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a symbol from the provided environment.
